title: Growth and Endocrinological Outcomes in Patients Who Underwent or Did Not Undergo Haematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation in Prepubertal Age
official: Growth and Endocrinological Outcomes in Patients Who Underwent or Did Not Undergo Haematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation in Prepubertal Age
summary: This observational study evaluates growth and endocrine outcomes in pediatric oncology patients who underwent prepubertal HSCT compared to those who did not. The study focuses on final height, pubertal growth spurt, and sex hormone production, with data collected retrospectively and prospectively through standard clinical follow-up.
